title: Autotune
description: Pulls a voice (one singer, or one monophonic instrument) to the right notes. Every moment gets the note it should be: a note of the key, the note the melody on target plays at that time, or a fix from the window. Speed 0 ms is the hard robot sound, 20 to 200 ms a natural correction. The vowels keep their colour (PSOLA).

inputs.name: target
inputs.title: Melody
inputs.description: Notes to sing (a midi-clip, a hum turned into MIDI): while a note plays the voice goes to that note, in the octave closest to what is sung. Between the notes the key decides.

inputs.name: region
inputs.title: Region in
inputs.description: A region (the joins of a loop) to process instead of audio. The result stays a region: it never reaches an audio input, only a region-merge block turns it back into audio.

outputs.name: region
outputs.title: Region out
outputs.description: The processed region. Connect it to another effect or to a region-merge block.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off passes the sound through untouched (bypass).

parameters.name: key
parameters.doc: The notes that are allowed: auto (found from what is sung), chromatic (every semitone), or a root and a scale: A minor, F# major, D dorian, C pentatonic, E minor-pentatonic, G blues, mixolydian, harmonic-minor.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.doc: How fast the voice is pulled to a new note: 0 ms is the hard robot sound, 20 to 50 ms a clear correction, 100 to 200 ms a soft natural one.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.doc: How much of the correction is used: 50% moves the voice half way to the note.

parameters.name: humanize
parameters.doc: How much slides between notes and the start of a note keep what was sung (0%: everything is corrected).

parameters.name: vibrato
parameters.doc: keep: the wobble of the voice stays around the right note; flatten: the voice is held straight on the note. A percentage (50%) keeps that much.

parameters.name: method
parameters.doc: Required. spectral (the default): a phase vocoder that keeps the formants (the colour of the vowels) apart from the pitch; usually the most natural, also for big moves. psola: one pitch period at a time, tighter and drier. A block without it gets AMP2016 with a quick fix that writes method spectral.

parameters.name: fixes
parameters.doc: Fixes by hand (the autotune window writes them): 4.2s-4.7s E4 sings an E4 there, 7.9s-8.4s G4 vibrato 0% also holds it straight, 12s-13s off leaves that part alone. Times are those of the block: seconds, ms or bars.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).
